fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. Uses one unified remote scene-anchor pipeline for physical furniture, free-standing and wall scenes, with synchronized participant alignment, scene controls and NPC undressing. v0.34.4 keeps the v0.34.3 direct/light furniture overlay replay and adds an immediate replay in the same visual tick that first observes a new CumOverlays snapshot. This deterministically supersedes the older delayed proxy RemoveOverlays/AddOverlays refresh before it can run, matching the ordering that made the third climax render correctly on both clients in testing. The T350/T1100 furniture passes remain as post-settle insurance; free-scene, PPA and OCum equip-mesh paths are unchanged.
